info.name: Flipturn Access IDs OCPP Messages API
List OCPP messages for a charger

params.name: chargerId
params.description: The ID of the charger to retrieve messages for.

params.name: startTimestamp
params.description: ISO 8601: messages after this time. Defaults to 24 hours ago.

params.name: endTimestamp
params.description: ISO 8601: messages before this time. Defaults to now.

params.name: messageType
params.description: Filter by OCPP message type(s), e.g. Authorize or messageType[]=StartTransaction.

params.name: nextPageCursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response's pagination.nextPageCursor to fetch the next page. Keep all other parameters identical.

items.docs: Retrieve raw OCPP (Open Charge Point Protocol) messages for a specific charger, newest first. The date range must be under 8 days. Page size is controlled by limit (default 50, max 500).
